worldcombat.skill.dive.summary: Dive under, then a surface wake runs along the ground to the locked spot and the user bursts out there: physical damage, flung upward and pushed back, and the target's fire put out. The wake telegraphs the landing, so a target that leaves before it arrives makes the strike miss; diving in water or soft ground reaches farther and hits harder.
worldcombat.skill.dive.description.0: The surfacing strike deals %1$s physical damage and throws the target about %2$s blocks upward and %3$s blocks back.
worldcombat.skill.dive.description.1: The wake starts %1$s ticks after diving and locks its landing; the burst covers about %2$s blocks around that spot. Diving in water or soft ground raises damage and launch by %3$s%%.
worldcombat.skill.dive.description.2: The landing is locked when the dive begins: a target that walks away or leaves the lock radius before the wake arrives makes the strike miss. Hard ground only allows a short shallow lunge (less range, damage and launch). Diving in water also puts out the user's own burn.
worldcombat.skill.dive.description.3: The burst leaves a spring for %2$s s in a %1$s-block radius: anyone passing through has their burn put out, and ground fire inside is put out for good.
worldcombat.skill.dive.stance.deep: Deep dive: a longer wake, higher damage and launch, but a longer dive and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.dive.stance.rush: Rush: shorter range and lower damage, but a fast dive and cooldown for close pressure.
worldcombat.skill.dive.timing: Recovers for %1$s s after firing, spends %2$s PP, with a %3$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.dive.growth.0: At level %1$s the knockback rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dive.growth.1: At level %1$s the knockback rises further to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dive.preference.deep.h: On (deep dive): a longer dive and wake, more damage and launch, but a longer cooldown. Off (rush): shorter range and damage, but a fast dive and cooldown for close pressure.
worldcombat.skill.dive.preference.ai.max: How far a foe may be before the companion considers Dive; lower keeps it close, higher lets it chase.
worldcombat.skill.dive.preference.ai.lea: When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to ambush a foe.
worldcombat.skill.dive.preference.ai.ope: With "Only isolated", the companion dives only when no other enemy is within 4 blocks of the target, instead of plunging into a crowd.
